goal: Read the navigation menu on this page and report whether every one of the five entries Home, About, Contact Us, Portfolio and Gallery is listed. Do not click anything.
notes: The page is static: what is listed on load is the result. One of the entries is dropped at random on some loads.

all_entries.when: The menu lists Home, About, Contact Us, Portfolio and Gallery

entry_missing.when: The menu lists Home, About, Contact Us and Portfolio but has no Gallery entry
entry_missing.note: this page drops an entry at random by design: across repeats the suite should report it flaky
